svg.title: Qwen3.8 processor-expanded visual tokens by frame format
svg.desc: A log-scale paired scatter compares contact-sheet and native-video visual tokens for 2,062 held-out trajectories. A second panel compares normalized bars for summed contact-sheet and native-video workloads in Corpus A, Corpus B, and both corpora pooled, with absolute totals and ratio-of-sums reductions labeled.
